_comment: Single source of truth for every Master Gate threshold and baseline seal. Read by gate_check.sh, parity_check.py, check_composite_gate.py and check_epistemic_invariants.py. Commits touching this file are blocked by the pre-commit hook unless RADIANCE_GATE_CHANGE=1 is set. Values carried over unchanged on 2026-10-08; tier1 floors and tier2 slack must be re-derived from measured run-to-run noise.
